perspective.publicDescription: Three Landings House receives effective notices under both Ferry Court 12 and Eastbank Service Road 4. Tenants request verification before a title hearing.

runtime.preparation: Obtain a tenant mandate and escorted survey consent; no search warrant or secret archive access.
runtime.testimony: Elsa Pike reports that tenants still use the old ferry entrance; her recollection is testimony, not proof of title.

sources.text: Registry certified title: Eastbank Service Road 4 was assigned to railway housing during reconstruction. Existing residents remain named as occupants.
Court-certified estate deed still describes Ferry Court 12 by the surviving ferry steps and names the same house frontage.
A household-authorized Meridian schedule insures the occupied house under Service Road 4 and references the reconstruction title.
Escorted measurements connect the ferry entrance and Service Road gate to one stairwell. Both posted numbers remain in use despite their incompatible boundary lines.
